Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting retail establishments from selling tobacco products where the establishment has a health care clinic on the premises.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the sale of tobacco in a facilitywhere a health care clinic is on the same premises; adding a newsection to chapter 70.54 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds tobacco products area danger to the public with severe health consequences for its users.As such, no tobacco product should be sold anywhere health careservices are offered or delivered.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.54 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Where a limitedservice health care clinic is located within alarger retail establishment, including supermarkets, department stores,and drug stores, the retail establishment may not sell tobaccoproducts. (2) For purposes of this section, "health care clinic" means anoffice or institution providing care or treatment of disease and where p. 1 HB 2257a providerpatient relationship is established and meeting appropriatestandards for a health care facility.
